name: Ultimate Wildmutt
abilities: Enhanced bite force (lifted and twisted an Esoterica with his jaws)
Sharp claws and teeth; scorpion-like spiked tail
Sightless sensing with enhanced smell and hearing
Bipedal as well as quadrupedal movement
weaknesses: No dedicated weakness section on the wiki; still eyeless (relies on smell/hearing) and has no ranged attack
summary: The evolved Vulpimancer: a bigger, crimson, spine-backed Wildmutt with a stinger tail who can stand upright - and, unlike his base form, actually talk.
traits: Last Ultimate form Ben ever used
'ULTIMATE WILDMUTT!' - 'I was gonna do that for you.'
Originally scripted to be chihuahua-sized and mute
notableFeats: Held down and defeated the invisible Prisoner 775 (Prisoner Number 775 is Missing)
Defeated the Esoterica, lifting one into the air with his jaws alone (The Ultimate Enemy: Part 2)

appearances.designNotes: Significantly larger and more muscular than Wildmutt; crimson fur; huge overlapping grey/white spikes running from a shark-like fin at the head in an arc down the back; long tail with a curved horned stinger tip; black lips; white claws; evolved Ultimatrix symbol on chest.

scoring.rationale: Bigger, stronger and armed with a stinger tail and crushing bite (pinned Prisoner 775, hoisted an Esoterica by jaw), plus he can talk - a real upgrade on Wildmutt, but still a melee-only tracker with two short outings and no ranged or special power to speak of.

notes: UA-only (two episodes). The OV crew never discussed giving Albedo this form; it was in an early 'Tangled Web: Part 2' outline but dropped.
Not among the sentient Ultimates in 'The Ultimate Sacrifice' despite the synopsis saying 'all' Ultimates wanted freedom.
Wiki lists no Weaknesses section; the weakness above is an inference for QA.

Ultimate forms are artificial by-products of the Ultimatrix's evolutionary function (added by Albedo): the DNA is run through a simulated worst-case scenario over millions of theoretical years to force combat-oriented evolution. They are not natural Codon Stream species, and the Omniverse Omnitrix has no evolutionary function, so Ben never regains them after UA (Derrick J. Wyatt).
